title: Recover JSON and YAML public callers from live table prestates
description: Bind each Configuration holder and its physical table and key lookups from the release bytes. Repeat the full registered JSON caller followed by YAML on the same checker. At every frozen selector, use fresh JVMs to distinguish the stock table, an invalid own property and the same invalid setting inherited from defaults. Verify the original selector and observer bytes, first versus repeated class initialization and two concurrent-in-lifetime configuration trees in both read orders.
expected: Bindings and original selector expectations agree on all four sides; a predicate refutation includes a fresh JVM counterexample and a default comparison on the same input; the inherited value provides a distinct membership control.

resources.notes: The original export missed two live JVM observer sources. This revision contains both compiled-probe inputs and their digest-checked driver.
